title: Refactor routing policy catalog lookup and candidate filtering
rubric: Public behaviour is byte-for-byte and value-for-value preserved for decide(), explain(), catalog_from_pricing(), catalog_entry(), RoutingError messages, and the demo/decide CLI commands.
The private _catalog_by_id(catalog) helper exists exactly once, builds the id-to-row mapping exactly once, and is used by _floor, decide, and _estimate instead of repeated ad hoc lookups.

The private _candidate_filter_reason(entry, floor, request, rules, excludes, explicit_effort, budget) helper owns the first-hard-filter decision and returns exactly one existing filter reason string or None.

decide() constructs candidates by calling _candidate_filter_reason once per catalog entry, and no longer duplicates the not-routable/unavailable/pinned/excluded/reserved/below-floor/over-budget checks inline.
The hard-filter ordering and first-reason semantics are unchanged, including the special unsupported-effort refusal supporter list and budget refusal behaviour.
Chosen-model handling uses the shared id lookup rather than a generator scan, while preserving the exact RoutingError for a missing chosen model.
No public constants, vocabulary tuples, returned dictionary keys, estimate structure, candidate reason lists, or human-readable explanation lines change.
Unit tests or equivalent coverage are added/updated for behaviour preservation and the refactor structure without adding dependencies or invoking real external CLIs.
